line: Bitcoin is drifting higher on spot ETF inflows; the news is mixed, led by regulation.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin +1.59% on the day, spot ETF net +6.7M USD (Oct 13, 2026), Fear & Greed 57 (greed), funding -0.0041% per 8h (calm)

wire_top3.line: South Korea's regulators blocked 27 crypto exchange websites, including Bitmart and Kucoin, tightening restrictions on unregistered platforms.
Russia's Sberbank won regulatory approval to offer crypto trading to all clients starting Dec. 1, beginning with BTC, ETH, and USDT.
BNY Mellon and Citadel Securities tested tokenized U.S. Treasuries on blockchain to accelerate Wall Street financing and collateral settlement.
